Affidavit should be filed latest by 3.00 PM on the last day of filing nominations.
Affidavit should be sworn before an Oath Commissioner or Magistrate of the First
Class or before a Notary Public.
All columns should be filled up and no column to be left blank. If there is no
information to furnish in respect of any item, either "NIL" or "Not applicable" as the
case may be, should be mentioned.
The affidavit should be either typed or written legibly and neatly.
Each page of the Affidavit should be signed by the deponent and the
Affidavit should bear on each page the stamp of the Notary or Oath
